# Darlingson Makuwila — Software Engineer

I'm Darlingson Makuwila, a software engineer based in Blantyre, Malawi, focused on backend systems and data-driven applications. I currently build web systems with C#/.NET and Laravel at Nico Technologies, and have a full-stack background across React, Vue, Next.js, Nuxt.js and Spring Boot.

## Projects
- Fast Budget: a daily-use, offline-first budgeting app built with React. https://fast-budget-eight.vercel.app
- Financial Overflow: analytics for the Malawi Stock Exchange, built with Next.js and Postgres. https://financial-overflow.vercel.app
- Mpira Analytics: football analytics for Malawi, built with Vue (in development). https://mpira-analytics.vercel.app
- Malawi Recipes: a mobile app for discovering Malawian cuisine, built with Flutter.
